attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 49, `rhoL` to `phoU`, are carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 25% of calls. The model names 54 to 100% of them, fewest at column 47, `pstA`, 54%.

**The middle is a fork and variable stretch**, columns 50 to 57, all shell, carried by 47 to 72%, the most plastic stretch of the window. Through columns 55 to 57 a branch of 3 families runs in 10 to 19%, [[type III effector]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 88%, and hesitates less there, 0.17 against 0.44 bits. Its most hesitant column, 5, `ppiC`, is a spine column, at 0.79 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 74 to 79, `recF` to `dgoR`, are carried by 20 to 90%, 4 persistent, 2 shell. The last column is `dgoR`, in 43% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.22 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.79 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 80% against 96%.

label: rhoL
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the rhoL window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rhoL, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,340 to 4,419 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rhoL once); 42,611 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,054 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 5,382 calls, named 77%, 0.75 bits; cloud 175 calls, named 13%, 3.71 bits. Outside an RGP 37,855 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 4,756 calls, named 80%, 0.79 bits. Columns: 66 spine, 5 fork, 9 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.79 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 96%); 4,756 of the 42,611 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 5 (ppiC, a spine column) 0.79 bits, RGP 0%; column 51 (bglF, a variable column) 0.72 bits, RGP 64%; column 56 (cbrC, a fork column) 0.63 bits, RGP 64%. The 7 columns (columns 51-56 and 79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 85%, 0.56 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 96%, 0.19 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 66 spine columns: named 96%, 0.17 bits on average; the 14 fork and variable columns: named 88%, 0.44 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 5, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 50-57 (fork and variable columns), RGP 46-69%; the least: columns 58-73 (spine), RGP 3-29%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-49 (50 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-25%. Genes: rhoL, trxA, rhlB, gppA, rep, ppiC, ilvC, ilvY, ilvA, ilvD, ilvE, ilvM, ilvG "acetolactate synthase 2 catalytic s…", ilvX, ilvL, yifB "YifB family Mg chelatase-like AAA A…", maoP, hdfR, yieP "FadR/GntR family transcriptional re…", mdtD, rbsR, rbsK, rbsB, rbsC "ribose ABC transporter permease", rbsA, rbsD, kup, ravA, viaA, asnA "aspartate--ammonia ligase", asnC, mioC, mnmG, rsmG, atpI, atpB, atpE, atpF, atpH, atpA, atpG, atpD "F0F1 ATP synthase subunit beta", atpC, glmU "bifunctional UDP-N-acetylglucosamin…", glmS, pstS, pstC "phosphate ABC transporter permease…", pstA, pstB, phoU. named 54-100% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 47 (pstA), named 54%; most hesitant at column 5 (ppiC), 0.79 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 50-57 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: share 47-72%, all S, RGP 46-69%. named 79-90% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 51, named 79%, 0.72 bits.
[S2.b55]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 55-57, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-19%, all S; the branch's families: "type III effector protein", "pentapeptide repeat-containing protein", espY4
[S2.c50]    50 fork: bglG S 67%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 17%
[S2.c51]    51 variable: bglF S 67% "PTS beta-glucoside transporter subu…"
[S2.c52]    52 variable: bglB S 66%
[S2.c53]    53 variable: bglH S 62%
[S2.c54]    54 variable: yieL S 64% "esterase"
[S2.c55]    55 fork: yieK S 70% "glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase"
[S2.c56]    56 fork: cbrC S 47% "PF03691 family colicin E2 tolerance…"
[S2.c57]    57 fork: cbrB S 72%
[S3] 3. columns 58-73 (16 columns) spine: share 92-97%, all P, RGP 3-29%. Genes: yieH "6-phosphogluconate phosphatase", adeP, yieF "class I chromate reductase YieF", yieE "4'-phosphopantetheinyl transferase…", yidZ "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…", mdtL, tnaA, tnaC "tryptophanase leader peptide", mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…", rnpA, rpmH, "protein YsdD", dnaA "chromosomal replication initiator p…", dnaN. named 93-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 58 (yieH), named 93%; most hesitant at column 66 (mnmE), 0.34 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 74-79 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: share 20-90%, 4 P, 2 S, RGP 8-59%. named 85-96% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 78, named 85%, 0.27 bits.
[S4.c74-78]    columns 74-78 variable, share 20-90%, 4 P, 1 S: recF 90%, gyrB 87%, yidB "YidB family protein" 77%, yidA "sugar-phosphatase" 80%, "lipoprotein" 20%
[S4.c79]    79 fork: dgoR S 43%; also yidX S 42%, dgoK S 22%, dgoA S 14%
